briefing: 今日导读：Anthropic提交IPO申请，揭示了公司收入的快速增长和亏损情况；CodeRabbit引入GPT-6.1 Sol加强安全；Greptile结合GPT-6 Astra提升漏洞检测效率。Nvidia考虑对每GPU每年收费2000美元，引发关注。
highlights: 今日看点：AI公司的IPO计划和新技术的整合显示了市场的活跃度和行业的快速变革。Anthropic的财务公布显示公司在盈利和技术投资间的拉锯，而Greptile与CodeRabbit通过先进模型提升漏洞检测和安全功能，强调了安全性在AI中的优先级。加之Nvidia的收费计划，预示着AI硬件成本的全面上涨，这样的变化或将影响AI初创企业的发展策略。

events.title: Anthropic 提交 IPO 申请
events.summary: Anthropic 正式提交 IPO 申请，披露了收入激增和逐渐加大的亏损。根据 S-1 文件，公司在今年上半年实现了 163 亿美元的收入，但净亏损达 807 亿美元，计划在纳斯达克上市，代码为“ANT”。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质 
Anthropic提交IPO申请，公开了其收入增长和持续的亏损情况。
### 为什么令人兴奋 
财务数据揭示了AI领域高增长高风险的特征，显示出对突破性技术的投资和追求。
### 产品机会 
此举或推动进一步研发创新，如GPT的更多变体及应用。
### 格局影响 
IPO可能为Anthropic带来大笔资金，加剧与OpenAI等巨头的竞争，创业公司面临更高的资本进入门槛。
### 冷静判断 
IPO仅是融资手段，成功上市后仍需证明盈利能力，以保持投资者信心。
### 趋势坐标 
延续AI领域热度和资本关注，同时揭示了公司盈利挑战，与近期多家公司财务情况相呼应。

articles.text: Anthropic has filed its S-1 prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Commission, preparing the company behind Claude to beat OpenAI to the punch with an IPO. In a filing with the SEC, Anthropic said it plans to list on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker symbol "ANT." The AI company confidentially filed with the SEC earlier this year in June, but the public document reveals more details, as well as the company's plans for the future in its own words, as well as potential risks for investors and the world. articles.title: Can AI help solve the COBOL code crisis?
articles.text: A computer running COBOL 73, an antiquated computer programming language, awaits taxpayer information entries at the Internal Revenue Service in Austin, Tx., on Friday, June 10, 2022. | Image: Getty Images What do the IRS, banks, airlines, and government infrastructure around the world have in common? They're all running on systems propped up by antique computer code that nobody dares touch, lest everything come crashing down. OpenAI thinks it may have a solution. On October 19th, the company touted "substantial improvements" in its latest AI models' ability to migrate aging software written in older programming languages into modern code, which it claims could help organizations with "maintaining and modernizing older systems."
